Zero-Code Integration
Connect Talview to Any LMS or Exam Platform No Coding Required
Book a Demo
2500+ Global Recruiters in Amazing Companies Like These Use Talview
Integrating secure online proctoring into your workflow shouldn’t mean months of IT work. With Talview’s Zero-Code Integration, you can connect our patented Agentic AI remote proctoring and interview security solutions to your LMS, exam engine, or assessment platform without writing a single line of code. We already support dozens of leading platforms and can add new integrations on demand to match your environment.
Why Zero-Code Integration is a Game Changer
Traditional integrations often mean:
Weeks of development time
API coding and troubleshooting
Manual CSV uploads
Long IT queues
Talview’s Zero-Code Integration:
Goes live in hours, not weeks
Requires no developer support
Minimizes errors and deployment risk
Scales instantly to new platforms
How It Works
Choose Your Platform
Select from our growing library of pre-built integrations. Need something new? We can add it for you.
Configure in the UI
Follow our guided setup no coding, no APIs, no technical complexity.
Sync & Launch
Import schedules, rosters, and exams directly into Talview.
Monitor & Report
Start secure remote proctoring immediately with real-time monitoring and comprehensive reporting.
Supported Platforms
Talview integrates out-of-the-box with popular LMS, exam engines, and custom platforms, including:
Learning Management Systems:
Moodle, Canvas, Brightspace (D2L), Blackboard, Schoology, Sakai, Open edX, Totara, TalentLMS, Adobe LMS, Cornerstone, Thinkific and more.
Exam Engines & Assessment Platforms:
TAO, Questionmark, Inspera, OpenOLAT, RM, Surpass, Risr, and more.
Custom / Proprietary Systems:
Any SCORM- or LTI-compliant platform, plus SSO-enabled environments.
Need a platform not listed? Our integration team can typically enable zero-code support within days.

FAQs: Zero-Code Integration
What is Zero-Code Integration?
A configuration-based way to connect Talview to your LMS or exam engine — no coding or custom APIs required.
Which platforms do you support?
We support a wide range of LMS and assessment platforms and can add new ones on request.
How quickly can a new platform be added?
Typically within a few days, depending on platform compatibility.
Is it secure?
Yes, we use industry-standard protocols like LTI, SSO, and secure connectors.
Can non-technical staff manage it?
Absolutely — the guided setup is designed for exam administrators and course managers.
Why Customers Love Us
We work hand in hand with Talview to enhance our Remote Proctoring capabilities and to improve our customer test taking journey.
Talview has been an essential part of our online learning product and have helped us to ensure that we meet and exceed our governance requirements. Talview has been a partner throughout online learning development and can’t recommend them enough.
